title: 第10章 结亲
content_zh:
第10章 结亲
李木田背着手才走到田家院前，院中哼着歌蹲着择菜的田芸已经抬头望了过来，见是李木田，于是腼腆地笑着道：
“李叔！”
又将手中的菜一放，连忙站起身，对着屋里喊道：
“爹！木田叔来了。”
“是我。”
李木田带着笑意应了句，上下打量着田芸。
这女孩三年来已经出落得水灵，身材前凸后翘，玲珑有致，虽然算不上俊秀但五官也算端正，倒是笑起来别有一番风情。
“不错，不错。”李木田背在身后的手一提，却是拎着一只大雁。
“李叔未免太客气了。”
田芸见着李木田提着东西来，不由一愣，再仔细一看，顿时惊声道：
“这是雁儿？”
《仪礼·士昏礼》曰：“昏礼，下达纳采。用雁。
“哈哈哈哈哈……”两位哥哥不禁失笑。
“我看还有沾亲带故的敢偷偷祭祀罢了。”
“我快要炼成八十一缕月华，凝聚玄景轮了！”李尺泾得意地抬头。
田守水五岁就跟在李木田身后，十二岁更是一同那任平安参了军，三人在军中抱团求生，不是兄弟胜似兄弟。
商量毕了婚事，李木田哼哼唧唧地回到院中，跨过前院，庭中只有三兄弟正在木桌前闲聊。
“放心吧爹，我有分寸。”
“好，好，太好了。”李项平兴奋地点点头。

“三弟，你倒是轻点折腾。”李通崖笑着轻骂一声，手中的刀笔却是不停，在木简上默刻着。
“元家还有未杀尽的族人？”李木田眉毛一挑，阴郁地开口道。
“大哥，好日子我就不该说这晦气话！”田守水给了自己一个嘴巴子，逗的李木田轻声笑起来。
“稀罕！”
他田守水已是与李家休戚与共，连李长湖都是他亲手带大，看得比自家孩子还要亲。
屋里的田守水才出了大门，闻言大大地松了口气，长久以来压在心头的石头落了地。
“前几日我上山途径那元家祖墓，听得有些动静，待到我回头去寻，却什么也未见着。”
“大哥！”田守水大笑着唤道。
“你们听着。”李木田却想着别的事，放下茶杯，严肃起来开口道：
“田家怎么说？”
“大哥，除了这婚事，却也有件要事”田守水无奈地摇摇头，正色道。
当父亲怎么看不出女儿一颗心早已挂在了那李项平身上！
只是这小子平日里滴水不漏，叫人看不出心思，田守水也怕女儿落得难堪，始终一言不发。
“至于通崖，我老了，说不动你了，你无意于村里的这些女人，但也得留下些子嗣吧……”
李木田抹了抹自己鬓角的白发，心中忧虑不已。
闻言，李项平直接从椅子上一跃而起，满脸焦急地盯着父亲。
“何事？”
后来回了村，杀了那大户元家，金盆洗手务起农来。李木田更是对自己处处照拂，分了田地，又做了媒让他娶了妻子。
几个兄弟也被这欣喜的氛围感染，纷纷露出笑容来，李长湖更是掐了掐李尺泾的脸蛋，直到这孩子连连叫苦才送开手。
院中，李项平正翻来覆去地看着那《接引法》，那布帛被蹂躏得满是折痕，墨迹都散开了不少。

“仙路虽说神妙无比，但谁知道潜伏着怎样的恐怖与危机，我们李家人丁稀薄，你们要是出了事，这李家谁来传承？”
“田芸说她稀罕你。”李木田缓缓饮了口茶，舒适地叹了口气。
农户小家小户，受不得太繁复的规矩，黎泾村中寻常人家别说是雁儿，空手上门提亲的也是大有人在，田芸也是头次见人纳采，方才反应过来。
自己已经五十多岁，虽说身体强健，衣食无忧，但世事无常，还是早些安排好家中事务罢！
“父亲！”
田守水心中惴惴不安，连忙自我安抚道。
自己的闺女能嫁到他家，哪能吃亏？
田芸才不知父亲心中过了多少道弯弯，见父亲出来就逃跑似的退下了，更是引得李木田一阵大笑。
一道清脆的叫声打断了院中有些压抑的气氛，李尺泾从屋中冲出，站定在几个哥哥面前。
“不错，你说的有道理。”李木田渐渐放松，对着田守水点点头：“当年确实也问过了，元家五口人，并无错漏。”
李木田跨过阶石，将木桌上的清茶一取，就地坐在了台阶上，漫不经心地道：
“我去田家提亲了。”
大哥李长湖在一旁对着田契细细算账，闻言一挑眉毛，道：
“他都折腾一上午了。”
“那便最好。”
“你也是一样。”李木田指指李项平，又看着李通崖无奈地叹了口气。
李木田有些疑惑地抬头。
“我家尺泾厉害。”
李通崖沉默着点点头，过了几个呼吸才开口道：
田芸早已从耳根红透到了脖颈，出于矜持与羞涩支支吾吾地想要掩饰，却又怕李木田当了真，只好开口道：

幼子李尺泾正在房中闭目修炼，白日里虽说月华稀薄进度缓慢，但李尺泾日夜刻苦修行。一点儿时间也不浪费。
在越国，男方欲与女方结亲，便会提着大雁上门，这一礼称之为纳采。
“我急忙给长湖定了亲，办了婚事，希望他速速诞下子嗣，就是怕何时出了事，我李家还能有一线生机。”
“我家那项平你可稀罕？”
从田家迈步出门，李木田脸色平静地走在土路上，若有所思地望着大黎山。
望着几个青年都认真起来，李木田摆摆手道：
“这法鉴即是我家的机缘，也会是我家的祸事。”
————
李木田哈哈一笑，起了逗逗她的心思。
李木田早就听幼子唠唠叨叨地说了这胎息之门玄景轮，不禁欣喜地抱了抱他，望着孩子哈哈大笑。
“下次接引符种还要等到夏至。”
李通崖看着欢乐一片的院中笑了笑，思忖道：
“晦朔日却是准备不齐错过了，下次便是夏至，再等几天即可。”
“修仙之道，李通崖来了。”
他静静地在木简上刻着《接引法》，内心却波涛汹涌，激动不已。
(本章完)

Chapter 10 Getting married
Li Mutian walked to the front of Tian's courtyard with his hands behind his back. Tian Yun, who was humming and squatting to choose vegetables in the courtyard, had already looked up and saw that it was Li Mutian, so she smiled shyly and said:
"Uncle Li!"
He put down the dishes in his hands, stood up quickly, and shouted into the room:
"Dad! Uncle Kida is here."
"It's me."
Li Mutian responded with a smile and looked Tian Yun up and down.
This girl has become very beautiful in the past three years. Her figure is convex and curvy, and she is exquisite. Although she is not handsome, her facial features are regular, and her smile has a unique charm.
"Not bad, not bad." Li Mutian raised his hand behind his back, but it was carrying a wild goose.
"Uncle Li is too polite."
When Tian Yun saw Li Mutian carrying something, she couldn't help but be startled. After taking a closer look, she suddenly exclaimed:
"Is this Yan'er?"
"Etiquette·Shihunli" says: "When the ceremony is at dusk, the ceremony is carried out. Use wild geese.
"Hahahahaha..." The two brothers couldn't help laughing.
"I think there are still some relatives who dare to secretly offer sacrifices. "
"I'm about to refine eighty-one rays of moonlight and condense the Xuanjing Wheel! "Li Chijing raised his head proudly.
Tian Shoushui followed Li Mutian when he was five years old, and he joined the army with Ren Ping'an when he was twelve years old. The three of them worked together in the army to survive. They were not brothers but brothers.
After discussing the marriage, Li Mutian hummed back to the courtyard and walked across the front yard. There were only three brothers chatting in front of the wooden table.
"Don't worry, Dad, I'm sensible. "
“Okay, okay, great. "Li Xiangping nodded excitedly.
"Third brother, please be gentle. "Li Tongya smiled and cursed lightly, but the knife and pen in his hand kept carving silently on the wooden slips.
"There are still members of the Yuan family who have not been killed? "Li Mutian raised his eyebrows and said gloomily.
"Brother, I shouldn't have said such unfavorable words in good times! Tian Shoushui gave himself a slap in the face, making Li Mutian laugh softly.
"Rare! "
He, Tian Shoushui, has shared weal and woe with the Li family. He even raised Li Changhu with his own hands, and he regarded him as closer than his own children.
Tian Shoushui, who was in the house, just walked out of the door. Hearing this, he breathed a sigh of relief, and the stone that had been weighing on his heart for a long time fell to the ground.
"A few days ago, I went up the mountain and passed by the Yuan family's ancestral tomb, and heard some movement. When I turned back to look for it, I saw nothing. "
"Brother! "Tian Shoushui called with a smile.
"Listen. But Li Mutian was thinking about other things, put down his tea cup, became serious and said:
“What did the Tian family say? "
"Brother, besides this marriage, there is also something important." Tian Shoushui shook his head helplessly and said seriously.
How could the father not see that his daughter's heart had already been fixed on Li Xiangping!
It's just that this kid is usually very tight-lipped, so people can't tell what he's thinking. Tian Shoushui is also afraid that his daughter will be embarrassed, so he never says a word.
"As for Tongya, I'm old and can't talk to you anymore. You have no interest in these women in the village, but you have to leave some heirs..."
Li Mutian wiped the white hair from his temples, worried in his heart.
Hearing this, Li Xiangping jumped up from his chair and stared at his father anxiously.
"What's the matter? "
Later, he returned to the village and killed the wealthy Yuan family. Jinpen then returned to farming. Li Mutian took good care of him, divided his land, and acted as a matchmaker to help him marry his wife.
Several brothers were also infected by the joyful atmosphere and smiled one after another. Li Changhu even pinched Li Chijing's face and did not let go until the child complained repeatedly.
In the courtyard, Li Xiangping was looking over and over at the "Jie Yin Fa". The cloth had been torn and wrinkled, and the ink marks were spread out a lot.
"Although the Immortal Road is very magical, who knows what kind of terror and crisis lurks there. Our Li family is very thin. If something happens to you, who will inherit this Li family? "
"Tian Yun said she cares about you. "Li Mutian slowly took a sip of tea and sighed comfortably.
Farmer's small familyHouseholds can't stand the complicated rules. In Lijing Village, let alone Yan'er, there are many people who come to propose marriage with nothing. Tian Yun is also the first to see someone accepting her favor, and she just reacted.
I am over fifty years old. Although I am in good health and have no worries about food and clothing, things in the world are unpredictable, so I’d better arrange my family affairs as soon as possible!
"Father!"
Tian Shoushui felt uneasy and quickly comforted himself.
How can he suffer if his daughter can marry into his family?
Tian Yun didn't know how many twists and turns her father had gone through, but she retreated as if running away when her father came out, which made Li Mutian laugh.
A crisp cry interrupted the somewhat depressing atmosphere in the courtyard. Li Chijing rushed out of the room and stood in front of his brothers.
"Yes, what you said makes sense." Li Mutian gradually relaxed and nodded to Tian Shoushui: "I did ask about it back then, and there was nothing wrong with the five members of the Yuan family."
Li Mutian stepped over the steps, took the tea from the wooden table, sat on the steps, and said casually:
"I went to Tian's house to propose marriage."
The eldest brother Li Changhu was calculating the accounts carefully for Tian Qi. Hearing this, he raised his eyebrows and said:
"He's been struggling all morning."
"That's best."
"The same goes for you." Li Mutian pointed at Li Xiangping, then looked at Li Tongya and sighed helplessly.
Li Mutian raised his head in confusion.
"My Chijing is great."
Li Tongya nodded silently, and after a few breaths he spoke:
Tian Yun had already turned red from her ears to her neck. She hesitated to hide it out of reservation and shyness, but she was afraid that Li Mutian would take it seriously, so she had no choice but to say:
The youngest son Li Chijing is practicing with his eyes closed in the room. Although the moonlight is thin during the day and the progress is slow, Li Chijing practices hard day and night. No time is wasted.
In the country of Yue, if a man wants to get married to a woman, he will come to the door with a wild goose. This ceremony is called nacai.
"I hurriedly arranged an engagement for Chang Hu and got married. I hope he will give birth to an heir soon. I am just worried that if something happens, my Li family will still have a chance to survive."
"Do you care about my Xiang Ping?"
Stepping out from Tian's house, Li Mutian walked on the dirt road with a calm face, looking at Mount Dali thoughtfully.
Seeing several young people becoming serious, Li Mutian waved his hand and said:
"This Dharma Book is both an opportunity and a disaster for my family."
————
Li Mutian laughed and thought of teasing her.
Li Mutian had long heard his youngest son talk about the Xuanjing Wheel of the Fetal Breath Gate, and couldn't help hugging him happily, looking at the child and laughing.
"The next time I pick up the talisman seeds, I have to wait until the summer solstice."
Li Tongya looked at the joyful courtyard and smiled, thinking:
"But I missed the Hui Shuo Day because I was not prepared. The next time is the Summer Solstice. Just wait a few more days."
"Cultivation of immortality, Li Tongya is here."
He was quietly carving "The Method of Acceptance" on the wooden slips, but his heart was filled with turmoil and excitement.
(End of chapter)
